verdict.rationale: Windmill is a developer platform with an API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack, however, never documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. Its llms.txt, markdown docs, CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
